components.name: Configs API
components.quote: The **configs API** is an **optional service** managing the configuration of Rulers and Alertmanagers.

components.name: Distributor
components.quote: The **distributor** service is responsible for handling incoming samples from Prometheus.

components.name: Hash ring
components.quote: A hash ring (stored in a key-value store) is used to achieve consistent hashing for the series sharding and replication across the ingesters.

components.name: High Availability Tracker
components.quote: The distributor features a **High Availability (HA) Tracker**.

components.name: Ingester
components.quote: The **ingester** service is responsible for writing incoming series to a [long-term storage backend](#blocks-storage) on the write path

components.name: Object store
components.quote: The only requirement is an object store for the Block files

components.name: PostgreSQL

components.name: Querier
components.quote: The **querier** service handles queries using the [PromQL](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/basics/) query language.

components.name: Query frontend
components.quote: The **query frontend** is an **optional service** providing the querier's API endpoints and can be used to accelerate the read path.

components.name: Query scheduler
components.quote: Query Scheduler is an **optional** service that moves the internal queue from query frontend into a separate component.

components.name: Ruler
components.quote: The **ruler** is an **optional service** executing PromQL queries for recording rules and alerts.

components.name: Store gateway
components.quote: The **store gateway** is the Cortex service responsible for querying series from blocks.
